description: This file defines the SugarApplication class, which manages core application logic in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for initializing sessions, handling user authentication, loading language and theme settings, controlling access rights, and managing redirects and message passing within the application.

classes.name: SugarApplication
classes.description: Main class managing application lifecycle, user sessions, access control, UI configuration, messaging, and redirection within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor; currently empty.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the main execution flow of the application, setting up the environment, controller, and executing the core request handling.

methods.name: loadUser
methods.description: Loads and authenticates the current user, establishing session and permissions.

methods.name: ACLFilter
methods.description: Filters modules based on access control permissions.

methods.name: setupResourceManagement
methods.description: Initializes resource management for a specified module.

methods.name: setupPrint
methods.description: Prepares the request string for printing or logging.

methods.name: preProcess
methods.description: Performs preliminary processing before main controller execution, such as password expiry checks and timezone settings.

methods.name: handleOfflineClient
methods.description: Manages offline client synchronization and configuration.

methods.name: handleAccessControl
methods.description: Checks and enforces access permissions for the current user and module.

methods.name: preLoadLanguages
methods.description: Loads minimal language resources before user login.

methods.name: loadLanguages
methods.description: Loads full language settings and module-specific strings.

methods.name: checkDatabaseVersion
methods.description: Verifies the database version matches application expectations.

methods.name: loadDisplaySettings
methods.description: Loads themes and display-related settings for the user.

methods.name: loadLicense
methods.description: Loads license information.

methods.name: loadGlobals
methods.description: Sets global variables related to current controller/module.

methods.name: isModifyAction
methods.description: Determines if the current action modifies data, requiring referrer checks.

methods.name: checkHTTPReferer
methods.description: Validates the HTTP referer for security, requiring referrer check for sensitive actions.

methods.name: startSession
methods.description: Starts the PHP session, handling custom session IDs and expired sessions.

methods.name: endSession
methods.description: Destroys the current session.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to a specified URL, supporting AJAX and standard redirects.

methods.name: headerRedirect
methods.description: Performs a redirect based on headers, parsing 'Location:' if present.

methods.name: appendErrorMessage
methods.description: Stores an error message in user session.

methods.name: getErrorMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and clears stored error messages.

methods.name: appendSuccessMessage
methods.description: Stores a success message in user session.

methods.name: getSuccessMessages
methods.description: Retrieves and clears stored success messages.

methods.name: appendMessage
methods.description: Helper to store messages of a specified type.

methods.name: getMessages
methods.description: Helper to retrieve and clear messages of a specified type.

methods.name: validateMessageType
methods.description: Validates message types for session storage.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Wrapper for setting cookies, considering headers sent and secure context.

methods.name: createLoginVars
methods.description: Creates URL parameters to preserve form data across login redirects.

methods.name: getLoginVars
methods.description: Retrieves login form variables, optionally including empty values.

methods.name: getLoginRedirect
methods.description: Determines the URL to redirect the user after login based on stored vars.
